“And the next time you’re mad at me, I’m going to remind you how great I am.
How loyal and kind and funny—” “Okay, okay, that’s enough!”
He ran out of the Frog Creek woods, across the street, and down the sidewalk.
She ran after Jack as fast as she could and caught up with him before he reached home.
